Pattern String.description: The exact interface text string extracted from the e-commerce webpage representing the potential dark pattern cue.
Pattern String.handling: Sanitized (HTML entities decoded, whitespace normalized). Rows with null/empty text are excluded from model training.

Pattern Category.description: The high-level dark pattern category according to e-commerce dark pattern taxonomies (e.g. Mathur et al., 2019).
Pattern Category.handling: Primary experiment focuses on 4 classes: Social Proof, Scarcity, Urgency, Misdirection. Obstruction, Sneaking, and Forced Action are excluded without relabeling.

Pattern Type.description: Specific sub-category or UI pattern mechanism (e.g., Activity Notification, Countdown Timer, Confirmshaming, Low-stock message).
Pattern Type.handling: Preserved for error analysis and qualitative breakdown.

Comment.description: Annotator observations detailing the visual or interactive presentation of the element (e.g., 'Periodic popup', 'Hardcoded in JS').

Where in website?.description: Location within the e-commerce purchase funnel where the cue was identified (Product Page, Cart Page, Home Page, Checkout Process, Other).

Deceptive?.description: Annotator determination of whether the pattern was deceptive, non-deceptive, or context-dependent ('Yes', 'No', 'Depends').

Website Page.description: Full URL source provenance indicating the e-commerce website where the pattern instance was observed and collected.
Website Page.handling: Preserved for verification and data audit.
